prompt: What is the real test result of the latest build on branch dev/datev-feed-receipts? Give me the tally line and any ERROR lines, and say which build id you read.

assertions.text: Names the build id of the latest build on the branch and confirms the branch from the page heading
Quotes the odoo.tests.result tally line verbatim
States whether ERROR-level lines exist after reading the whole install.log, not only the tail
Reports the badge as a secondary signal and names the database the result was read on
Performs no action beyond reading (no Rebuild, Connect, SSH or RPC)
